title: fix: prevent /M tokens unit label from overflowing pricing card on mobile
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
Prevents the /M tokens unit label overflowing pricing card on mobile 
Affected page: models page showing pricing table (e.g. gen.pollinations.ai models/pricing route).
Device: mobile browser (narrow viewport).
Expected: pricing rows fit within the card/container width, or unit label wraps/stacks.
Actual: /M tokens extends past the right edge of the container.
Closes #13867

gist.headline: Tokens stay in the garden
gist.blurb: The little “/M tokens” label has stopped wandering off the edge of mobile pricing cards. Even units deserve a container.
gist.summary: Fixed the models pricing badge so the “/M tokens” unit wraps within its card instead of overflowing on narrow mobile viewports.
gist.impact: Mobile users can now read model pricing rows cleanly without the token unit extending past the card edge.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper wearing a tiny tool belt, gently tucking a small “/M tokens” sign back inside a cozy lime-green pricing-card planter. Include a narrow retro phone screen, neat stacked pricing rows, and small flowers or code-plants growing around the card to represent responsive layout behaving itself.
